app.errorBody: CoTime needs the internet to set up your player. Check your connection and try again.

onboarding.tagline: Phones down. Eyes up. Loser gets bombed.
onboarding.title: Who are you?
onboarding.subtitle: Snap a selfie — it's the face your friends will crack, burn and blow up when you reach for your phone.

profile.title: Your player
profile.tapToPreview: Tap your face to preview your fate
profile.cameraDenied: Camera access is off. Allow it in Settings, or pick from Photos.
profile.photoFailed: Couldn't use that photo. Try another one.
profile.soundsHint: Sirens and explosions — even on silent mode.

home.heroSubtitle: Ready, {{name}}? First one to touch their phone gets bombed.
home.how1: Start a game and share the code with the table.
home.how2: Everyone puts their phone face down. Screen stays on.
home.how3: Pick yours up and your face gets cracked, burned… or bombed.

suddenDeath.title: Sudden Death
suddenDeath.tagline: First to touch their phone loses. Instantly.
suddenDeath.rules: The first person to pick up their phone ends the game — and gets their face nuked. Nobody cracks before the timer? Everyone wins.

threeStrikes.title: Three Strikes
threeStrikes.tagline: Every pickup costs a life. Last one standing wins.
threeStrikes.rules: Each pickup costs a heart and cracks your face a little more. Run out of hearts and you get blown up. Last player standing wins.

zen.title: Zen Master
zen.tagline: Fewest pickups by the end wins.
zen.rules: Play for a set time. Fewest pickups wins; ties go to whoever spent less time on their phone. Most pickups gets bombed at the end.

timeBank.title: Screen Time Budget
timeBank.tagline: Everyone gets a few minutes of phone. Spend wisely.
timeBank.rules: Everyone gets the same phone-time budget for the night. The clock only runs while your phone is in your hand. Burn through it and you explode.

create.title: New game

noLimitHint.threeStrikes: Runs until one player is left.
noLimitHint.zen: Zen Master needs a time limit.
noLimitHint.timeBank: Runs until one player has budget left.

create.durationHint: When time's up, the game ends on every phone.

lobby.shareMessage: Phones down! Join my CoTime game with code {{code}} — {{link}}
lobby.soloHint: It's more fun with friends — share the code first.
lobby.tip1: When the countdown starts, put your phone face down on the table.
lobby.tip2: Don't lock it — the screen stays on so CoTime can tell when it moves.
lobby.tip3: Touching the screen, leaving the app or lifting the phone all count as a pickup.

live.putItDownHint: Flat on the table. Don't lock it.
live.graceLeft: {{seconds}}s before it counts as a pickup
live.touchWarning: Touching the screen counts as a pickup
live.outHint: Your phone is all yours now. Everyone saw.
live.putItBack: Put it back face down to keep playing
live.endGameMessage: Everyone goes to the results screen right now.

results.nobodyOwes: Nobody lost — "{{stake}}" is off the hook.

session.alreadyStarted: This game already started without you.

errors.permission: Not allowed. Try again from the start.
errors.SESSION_NOT_FOUND: No open game with that code.
errors.NOT_HOST: Only the host can do that.
